altitude_15plus_vertical_rate_separate_t.note: 15+ m/s vertical-rate band has large train-vs-all p95 difference and should be treated separately or excluded from altitude effect strata
altitude_15plus_vertical_rate_separate_t.recommendation: Report altitude effect strata for 0-5 and 5-15 m/s bands only; report 15+ m/s descriptively. Use one altitude shift size per tier across both variants (baro_only and baro_plus_geo), calibrated from the 0-5 m/s band where baro and geo p95 are closest.

eq12_noise_semantics.equation: x~'_i = x~_i + kappa * s, where s ~ N(0, per_step_noise_sigma_meters)
eq12_noise_semantics.interpretation: kappa scales the noise contribution; per_step_noise_sigma_meters is the standard deviation of the base noise distribution in meters
eq12_noise_semantics.note: kappa * per_step_noise_sigma_meters is the effective standard deviation of added noise per step. At gross tier, kappa=0 means no noise.

freeze_90s_feasibility.note: 90s freeze is evaluable at boundary+interior stratum only, not interior-only
freeze_90s_feasibility.reason: interior zone (3 rows) < window_rows (30), so no window can contain only interior rows

parameters.reporting_gate: attack-specific quantity compared to train-split speed-band p95; used for reporting strata, NOT for primary dataset generation
parameters.truth_rule: at least 5 attacked rows; detectability is reported separately as strata

full_field.reporting: ungated eligibility and boundary-stratified results only; no interior residual gate is scientifically valid
